components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main learner action, such as checking an answer.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #1c456b; color: #fff; font: 500 14px/20px Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #173855; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(110 156 197 / 0.5); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary or answer-choice action with a quiet border.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #dce4eb; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #1b3043; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font: 500 14px/20px Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: #e8eef5; color: #1c456b; } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(110 156 197 / 0.5); } .ds-button-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact field for search, labels, or document metadata.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="Tìm tài liệu" placeholder="Tìm tài liệu" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #dce4eb; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #1b3043; font: 400 14px/20px Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5d7082; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #6e9cc5; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(110 156 197 / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #b93e37; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(185 62 55 / 0.2); }

components.name: Lesson Card
components.description: White bordered surface for a lesson or study document.
components.html: N5 · Từ vựngBài học đã duyệt
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #dce4eb; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #1b3043; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #789cba; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(110 156 197 / 0.5); }

components.name: Level Badge
components.description: Compact JLPT level marker on a lesson.
components.css: .ds-level-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e8eef5; color: #315b85; font: 700 14px/20px Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Header Link
components.description: Compact learner navigation or return link in the white header.
components.css: .ds-navigation-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #1c456b; font: 500 14px/20px Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-navigation-link:hover { background: #eef5fb; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-navigation-link:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(110 156 197 / 0.5); }

components.name: Practice Option
components.description: Full-width answer choice with visible selected and feedback states.
components.css: .ds-practice-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 62px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #dce4eb; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; color: #1b3043; text-align: left; font: 500 16px/24px Arial, 'Noto Sans JP', 'Yu Gothic', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-practice-option:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #b4c1cb; background: #fafbfc; } .ds-practice-option[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #8ca1b3; background: #f5f7f9; } .ds-practice-option:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(110 156 197 / 0.5); } .ds-practice-option:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Manabi Brand
components.description: Shared linked wordmark for learner route headers, with full and compact layouts.
components.css: Uses Harbor Ink for the wordmark and Notebook Coral for the terminal dot; compact headers omit the 日 tile.

narrative.overview:
Manabi is a calm, practical workspace for Vietnamese-speaking independent learners studying Japanese and preparing for the JLPT. Mist surfaces, clear type, and familiar controls keep attention on the next study action. Harbor Ink carries the main hierarchy; Notebook Coral marks a small number of identity and progress cues.

The interface should make it easy to answer a question, understand its explanation, and revisit learning material. Keep Vietnamese guidance legible beside Japanese study text, and use clear states to distinguish a sample, an AI draft, a learner-confirmed lesson, and reviewed public material. The isolated `/kage-preview` route embeds a separate authored visual world; keep it scoped to that preview rather than applying its styling to Manabi learner flows.
keyCharacteristics: Cool Mist surfaces with white work panels and fine blue-gray borders.
Harbor Ink establishes hierarchy; Notebook Coral stays a small cue.
Japanese examples receive room to breathe within Vietnamese-language guidance.

rules.name: The Coral Cue Rule
rules.body: Keep Notebook Coral to small identity or progress cues. Use Harbor Ink for primary actions and study links.

rules.name: The Study-First Type Rule
rules.body: Set Japanese study text apart through size and spacing while keeping the surrounding Vietnamese explanation easy to find.

rules.name: The Quiet Rest Rule
rules.body: Keep the practice surface close to the page; reserve stronger depth for items that invite browsing.

dos: **Do** use Harbor Ink for primary actions and Notebook Coral for small brand or progress cues.
**Do** keep Vietnamese guidance and Japanese study text visually connected and easy to distinguish.
**Do** use clear borders and Mist-to-White contrast to define work areas.
**Do** preserve honest visual differences between sample, draft, confirmed, and approved learning content.
**Do** keep `/kage-preview` isolated from the Manabi learner interface.
donts: **Don't** spread Notebook Coral across large surfaces or use it as the default action color.
**Don't** rely on color alone for answer correctness or content review state.
**Don't** mix Kage’s separate preview styling into Manabi’s learner routes.
**Don't** add shadows to every panel; use depth only where a control or browsing choice needs it.
